correctness.rationale: For crown C_n=K_{n,n} minus the diagonal matching, n>=3, the four orthogonal Laplacian spectral projectors with eigenvalues 0,n,n-2,2(n-1) give all orbit entries. The paired nonedge entry is exactly (n-2)(n-1) h^3(1-(n-1)h)/6; same-side quadratic has strictly negative discriminant; existing-edge expression h[(1-z)(1+A z²)+z²/3] positive on 0<z<1; R4(-t)>0 yields positive diagonals. Thus no return beyond 1/(n-1). For intact K_nn the across-part entry 1-R4(-2nh) and scalar convexity yield cutoff rho/(2n), rho unique positive root t³-4t²+12t-24. 8/3<rho<3 gives opposite deletion comparisons n=3 versus n>=4. Independently reconstructed 28 direct rational dense matrices n=3..9 and scalar orbit identities; these finite tests supplement the all-n proof.

value.rationale: An exact all-size one-step cone-positivity horizon and a counterintuitive sharp edge-deletion reversal on a natural regular graph family. It distinguishes completed RK4 positivity from spectral norm stability and from positivity of intermediate stages, which is directly relevant to choosing timesteps on graph diffusion.
